issues.title: The bench cradle cannot set the stops of the recommended 50 kg cell
issues.evidence: layer_ascii.py slices of cad/print/stl/cradle.stl, print z 9-50: the rear upright is a free-standing 50 x 8 plate; the 6 mm side walls stop at print y -2, 42 mm short of it. Jack axis 49.1 mm above the base top. At 1.2 x FS of 50 kg (589 N): 54 MPa across layers at the upright root and 56 MPa in the 7.9 mm base (review row 'a5R bench cradle ... 50 kg' FAIL 54.19 > 25). Tip deflection 3.6-4.4 mm, but the M5 x 20 head stands 3.0 mm off the upright (cadcheck warn FST_Jack_screw), so the stroke runs out (row 'a5R bench jack stroke' FAIL 4.47 > 3.0). The jack tilts 6.4-7.6 deg, so it is no longer on the axis. With a 20 kg cell: 22 MPa (row passes at 21.7), and 27 MPa when README step 7 turns the jack on past 120 % to 150 %. head_check_a5.txt section F
issues.fix: Close the frame: run both 6 mm side walls from the front block to the rear upright (y 35.7 to 114 world), full height to z -8, with 14 x 10 key windows over the four stop heads. The load then goes in the layer plane: about 1.2 MPa in the side walls, and about 11 MPa in the upright bending between the walls (38 mm span). Thicken the upright to 10 mm. Use an M5 x 30 jack (10 mm of stroke). Add 3 mm fillets at the upright/base and wall/base roots

issues.title: The stop-setting procedure never sets the cell's rated output, so '120 %' can be 60-80 % of the real FS
issues.evidence: firmware/bench_hx711.ino: ratedMvV = 1.0 by default; %FS comes from mV/V unless 'r' or 'c' is used. README 'Setting the overload stops' step 4 says only 'f 20 (or f 50), then t'; grep for 'mV' in README.md finds nothing. A 1.5 or 2.0 mV/V cell sets the stops at 80 % or 60 % of true FS (head_check_a5.txt H). With a 20 kg cell at 60 % FS, the push reading clips at 118 N
issues.fix: README step 4: 'f 20, r <rated mV/V from the cell's label or certificate>, t; then hang a known 10 kg on the plug and check that the line reads 50 % (20 kg) or 20 % (50 kg) +-3 %, else use c 10'. Make the sketch refuse 'm' until 'r' or 'c' has been given

issues.severity: minor (major only with a 20 kg cell)
issues.title: 20 kg cell still past its safe overload at a 600 N shove, and side load clips it in the working range
issues.evidence: head_check_a5.txt A: 20 kg at 600 N = 1.44-1.92 x FS (k_stop 6.0, shared PLA path in series) or 1.40-1.82 (designer's 7.6). Section B: 50 N sideways closes one push screw 0.042 mm, so a 20 kg push stop engages at 0.78 FS = 154 N (50 kg: 384 N)
issues.fix: Fit the 50 kg cell, as the BOM recommends, after the issue 1 cradle fix. Then change the BOM text from 'Alex decides' to the 50 kg cell, and keep the 20 kg cell only with dFS >= 0.15 mm

issues.title: Lean-to-axial crosstalk: 3.8 % of a downward grip load reads as axial force
issues.evidence: The leaf tops are at z -15, 15 mm below the cell axis (cad q list: PRT_movlink_R; ground top -42, leaf_free_len 27). When the link pitches, the cell holds y at z 0, so the leaf tops shift 15 x theta and turn by theta. The shear EI/L^2 (12 x 15/L + 6) theta can only leave through the cell. 50 N lean gives 1.9 N and 150 N gives 5.7 N (0.4 / 1.2 % FS of 50 kg). Review row 'a5R lean-to-axial crosstalk' 5.69 N, limit 10 N. head_calc does not model it. The README 5 kg check (< 2 % FS) passes with it
issues.fix: Firmware dead band of at least 10 N, and record the 5 kg bench reading as the crosstalk coefficient. For a structural fix (next cartridge print), raise the leaf tops to the cell axis + 13.5 mm (leaf mid-length on the axis): ground bar to z -13.5, link bottom to z +13.5

issues.title: head_calc levers the link pitch about the cell centre, not the leaf centroid
issues.evidence: head_calc.py section 4: link_only = th1 x (lip - y_cell), lever 96.4 mm. The free model's pitch centre is the leaf centroid y 85.5 (lever 64.5). Link-only contact moves from 399-559 to 596-835 N, and with piston bending from 158-221 to 181-254 N. The conclusions hold (the leaf is x5.3 below buckling at contact)
issues.fix: Use (lip - y_leaf) in the free model. Keep (lip - y_cell) only for the pinned model, and report both

issues.title: Soldering iron needed (lead to HX711 JP4), not in the tool list; a cell swap means desoldering
issues.evidence: README step 8: 'Solder its conductors to the HX711's JP4'. The tools are a DeWalt drill, bits and hex keys. A cell swap also means a fin teardown (3 M4 + 6 M3 + 2 M3), an overnight settle and a stop re-set
issues.fix: Use an HX711 board with a 4-way screw terminal (or fit a 3.5 mm pluggable terminal block on JP4), driven with the 2 mm flat bit from the set. Say so in the BOM

issues.title: Lip friction past a 180-250 N lean; the piston is at 40 MPa at 600 N
issues.evidence: Contact at 181-254 N per grip, after which the lip reaction is 2.74 x the lean (1642 N at 600 N). Piston 20 / 40 / 54 MPa at 300 / 600 / 800 N in the layer plane (I 11456 mm4)
issues.fix: Keep the README limit ('not trusted above about 150 N lean'), which sits below the reviewer's 181 N contact. Optionally wrap a PTFE tape band on the piston over y 146-150 to cut the lip friction, and add a firmware flag when the crosstalk term (issue 4) implies a lean over 150 N
